name: R2 M6 Longbow of the Guardian Star

system.description:
[Trigger: Action]: Use this effect at the same time as a [Ranged Attack]. Secondary targets within [Target: Wide 1 (P) / Range: Close] from you gain [Barrier: (Base POW + 5)]. Limit 1/Scenario.

A small bow carved into a sacred tree with a pattern resembling a protective star inn, and forged as a ritual tool. If you pluck the strings with a prayer, the radiance of Yumihariboshi will give protection to those around you.

Cuddling Husband and Wife Tree [Core Material] (40G) + Short Bow (110G) + Aoi Amulet (60G) + [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) x 2 + Crafting Cost (100G)
